title: Draft from your documents
caption: Add your documents and draft modules, lessons and quizzes from them. The draft is told never to invent a rule your documents don't contain, and you edit everything before it goes out.

title: Presenter videos
caption: Choose a presenter, write what they say, and make the video. Learners see it marked as AI generated, and nobody's photo is used until their consent is recorded.

title: Learners
caption: No accounts. Lessons, quizzes with an explanation for every answer and unlimited retakes, then a confirmation in their own words and a certificate.

title: Records
caption: Every assignment, lesson, attempt and confirmation is recorded with its time. See who is overdue, copy their link, and export the record for an auditor.
